subject.title: deepseek provider: config apiKey 字段被静默忽略 + 默认 model 名 deepseek-chat 已被平台下线

question: Should `openclaw doctor --fix` automatically rewrite existing `deepseek-chat` and `deepseek-reasoner` selections to DeepSeek V4 Flash configurations, or should it stop and require the operator to choose the replacement mode?
rationale: DeepSeek’s retired ids make the existing catalog unsafe, but automatically mapping a reasoning alias to a new V4 mode changes persisted provider behavior and needs an explicit compatibility decision.

options.title: Add a narrow doctor migration
options.body: Map the legacy aliases to documented V4 Flash settings while preserving non-thinking versus thinking intent, with focused upgrade coverage.

options.title: Fail with guided recovery
options.body: Remove the retired ids and have doctor report each legacy setting with a visible command or picker path for the operator to select V4 Flash or V4 Pro.

recommendation.title: Add a narrow doctor migration
recommendation.body: Map the legacy aliases to documented V4 Flash settings while preserving non-thinking versus thinking intent, with focused upgrade coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: The available feature-history evidence connects this person to the merged DeepSeek V4 provider work and its onboarding/runtime contract.
